answer: Prove presence, not just keys: at an unpredictable pulse, the network names a public anchor and broadcasts a one-time raven code. An identity stays eligible only by collecting, within minutes, co-signatures from three unrelated witnesses physically at that anchor who saw the code displayed there. One operator cannot be in many places at once, and reusing the same witness set across shells exposes the farm, so each extra identity demands a distinct local presence that cannot be copied or batched.
